suppressions.rationale: Workspace-header groups and identity hide or reveal at toolbar container widths (workspace-header.css) until Kerf ships width-threshold visibility (KF-MXE9YV); remove when HS2 adopts it.
The expanded grouped search anchors its suggestion, date, and help surfaces below the group (ticket-search-field.css) until Kerf ships a supported anchor (KF-M8SV15); remove when HS2 adopts it.
The gallery filename ToolbarText uses light-on-dark text in the dark toolbar (attachment-gallery.css) until Kerf ships a ToolbarText tone (KF-7288MD); remove when HS2 adopts it.
